description: This is a shell script for testing the behavior of the 'safe.bareRepository' configuration in Git. It includes test cases that check how Git handles various configurations related to bare repositories, including implicit, explicit, and nested configurations, as well as the presence of submodules and worktrees.

methods.name: expect_accepted_implicit
methods.description: Checks that a command with implicit repository identification passes and traces correctly.

methods.name: expect_accepted_explicit
methods.description: Checks that a command with explicit GIT_DIR passes without trace indicating implicit repo.

methods.name: expect_rejected
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails appropriately when using an invalid or restricted repository setting and that relevant errors and traces are present.
